BiblicalUsage: Pâçag occurs once, in the psalm that tells God's people to walk about Zion, mark her bulwarks, and consider her palaces, that they may tell it to the generation following.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this one verse hands me my work: walk around what God has built, look closely, and tell the next generation.
